settings.text: Each panel is made by hand, reflecting thoughtful craftsmanship and a refined attention to detail.

settings.title: Pleat Depth
settings.text:
Curtain depth refers to the side profile of the curtain—how much space the drapery occupies from front to back.

Typical overall depth ranges from 3 1/2" to 3 7/8".

When hanging with rings, the distance from the rings to the back of the curtain is about 2 1/8".

settings.title: Side Hem & Bottom Hem
settings.text:
Our drapery features clean, tailored hems with a Cozyology logo binding on the back for a refined finish.

Invisible from the front, this detail adds a discreet, elevated touch to the craftsmanship.

The side hem measures 1 1/4", and the bottom hem measures 3 1/4".

These measurements are already included in the finished panel width and length, so no additional allowance is required on your end.

settings.title: Tieback Size
settings.text:
Tiebacks feature dual button positions for an adjustable fit.

Each tieback measures approximately 5" in height, while the length is custom-made based on your curtain’s width, pleat count, and fabric thickness.

Most tiebacks typically fall within 9"–32", depending on the drapery’s shape and softness.

Designed to complement your curtains, each tieback is custom crafted—no measuring required.
